QuestionStmt.S: The rate constant for the reaction $2\mathrm{N_2O_5(g)} \rightarrow 2\mathrm{N_2O_4(g)} + \mathrm{O_2(g)}$ is $4.98 \times 10^{-4} \, \text{s}^{-1}$. What is the order of reaction?

Solution.S: The unit of the rate constant gives information about the order of the reaction. For a first-order reaction, the unit of k is s⁻¹. Since the given rate constant has the unit s⁻¹, the reaction is first order. Hence the correct option is B: 1.
